title: StringRoleId
description: Browser-specific. Schema representing a string role.

oneOf.title: StringRoleDefault
oneOf.description: The default string role, used for uncategorized strings. Strings added by an AddStringChange are added to this string role.

oneOf.title: StringRoleNodeName
oneOf.description: A string role containing DOM node names (e.g. 'div', '#text').

oneOf.title: StringRoleAttributeName
oneOf.description: A string role containing DOM attribute names.

oneOf.title: StringRoleAttributeValue
oneOf.description: A string role containing DOM attribute values.

oneOf.title: StringRoleTextContent
oneOf.description: A string role containing DOM text content.

oneOf.title: StringRoleFormInput
oneOf.description: A string role containing DOM form input values.

oneOf.title: StringRoleCSS
oneOf.description: A string role containing CSS inline styles and stylesheets.

oneOf.title: StringRoleResourceId
oneOf.description: A string role containing resource IDs.
